name: autopatch
description: Deterministic, AST-driven API migrations with an in-memory TypeScript verification gate.

scripts.smoke:llm: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local --import tsx bin/autopatch.ts --from tests/fixtures/live/v1.json --to tests/fixtures/live/v2.json --project tests/fixtures/live/tsconfig.json --bindings tests/fixtures/live/bindings.json --max-attempts 1 --timeout-ms 30000 --dry-run --json
scripts.demo: tsx bin/autopatch.ts --from tests/fixtures/openapi-v1.json --to tests/fixtures/openapi-v2.json --project tests/fixtures/target/tsconfig.json --bindings tests/fixtures/target/bindings.json
